root_cause: 1) When extracting child Vue components from parent view, leaving CSS in parent scoped block breaks selector inheritance. 2) QA subagent ran chrome-devtools-mcp emulate(375x812) without resetting viewport back to Desktop (1440x900) upon completion. 3) Missing gap on inline-flex telemetry items and 3-button footer rows bloated mobile card height.
prevention_rule: 1) Always migrate matching scoped CSS rules into child components and inspect rendered screenshots via view_file. 2) Every QA chrome-devtools-mcp audit MUST reset emulation to Desktop 1440x900 (isMobile: false, deviceScaleFactor: 1) as its final step. 3) Mobile cards must use compact 2-row layout (~68-72px) without 3rd-row button spam, and never show contradictory status.

root_cause: 1) QA subagent saw port 8080 down and spawned scratch mock-api-server.cjs with fake hosts while stale localStorage held active cluster. 2) Frontend contained synthetic UI loops (16 fake timestamps from single scalar) and fake badges. 3) View stylesheets bypassed tokens.css with hardcoded neon cyberpunk hex colors (#38bdf8, #06b6d4, #34d399, #fb7185) and duplicate summary strips.
prevention_rule: 1) Forbid QA from ever creating scratch mock servers; always run real Go backend and clear stale mock localStorage keys. 2) Purge synthetic computed loops and fake badges. 3) Enforce tokens.css neutral surface ladder: zero raw neon hex overrides, semantic colors restricted to 6px status dots, clean typography, zero duplicate status strips.

root_cause: 1) Leaving hardcoded dark-mode rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.7) in stylesheets caused Light Mode to render muddy dark cards on white canvas with unreadable dark text. 2) Duplicate KPI panels on the same screen. 3) GlobalContextSelector missing .status-dot. 4) Hardcoded max-width on tables caused 250px right-edge gaps on desktop.
prevention_rule: 1) Sweep all stylesheets and scoped blocks so zero hardcoded rgba(15, 23, 42, ...) backgrounds remain. 2) Always verify BOTH Dark Mode and Light Mode via chrome-devtools-mcp screenshots and inspect with view_file. 3) Never duplicate KPI counts across stacked panels. 4) Use 100% proportional column widths on full-width data tables.

root_cause: Subagent created scratch file (probe_db.go) containing hardcoded Postgres DSN credentials instead of loading DATABASE_URL / DB_* from .env via os.Getenv, violating Rule 7 (Never commit, log, or store secrets, tokens, or credentials).
prevention_rule: 1) Explicitly forbid subagents in every dispatch prompt from writing hardcoded passwords, DSNs, or tokens anywhere including scratch scripts; always load .env into env vars and call os.Getenv. 2) Dispatch security-engineer to audit repo and scratch whenever database, auth, or agent tokens are touched.

root_cause: 1) Subagents defaulted to manual grep/find loops instead of leveraging indexed CodeGraph (.codegraph/: 1,554 files, 25,609 nodes, 70,311 edges). 2) Across 8 operational screens, coders reused cookie-cutter Admin CRUD layout ([Search + Filter Pills + Add Create] -> [Generic table]), stripping domain SRE visual hierarchy.
prevention_rule: 1) Mandatory dispatch prompt instruction: call codegraph_explore (MCP ServerName codegraph, projectPath d:\\project\\k8sseflhost, or shell codegraph explore) FIRST before grep/find/reading files. 2) Enforce Zero Cookie-Cutter CRUD Clones: every view must implement its domain Job-to-be-Done visual paradigm (Hardware Blades for /hosts, Workload Topology for /deployments, Burn-Rate Gauges for /slo, Compliance Scorecards for /audit, Pipeline Cards for /automation, Playbook Runner for /runbooks).

root_cause: Invented manual multi-line PowerShell scp/ssh commands and built into bin/k8s-agent instead of using repository canonical root script deploy-agent.sh (which builds ./k8s-agent static linux/amd64, copies via /tmp, cleans legacy >150 part_* floods, preserves remote ~/.k8s-agent/agent.env, and restarts systemd --user k8s-agent.service in one command).
prevention_rule: Always inspect and instruct with project canonical deployment scripts (e.g., ./deploy-agent.sh <user>@<ip> or ./deploy-agent.sh locally on Linux) rather than reinventing manual ad-hoc scp/ssh shell snippets.

root_cause: 1) Subagent guessed live PostgreSQL column types/nullability from migration files across 2 attempts instead of reading the verbatim server error log and querying live information_schema.columns. 2) Passing a nil Go pointer (*string = nil) into a parameterized INSERT column defined as TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' explicitly binds SQL NULL, bypassing PostgreSQL's column DEFAULT '' and triggering SQLSTATE 23502.
prevention_rule: 1) Before fixing any DB repository error, read the verbatim backend error log and query live information_schema.columns (loading .env via os.Getenv without exposing secrets). 2) Never convert empty Go strings to nil pointers for NOT NULL DEFAULT '' columns; bind the empty string directly and verify against live DB when reachable.

root_cause: 1) Legacy observability_repo.go returned 100.0% when slo_health_samples had 0 rows and deployment_repo.go returned hardcoded fallbackFleetWorkloads(), masking unmeasured or offline services as healthy. 2) When down services produced burn_rate = 1000.0..2000.0, PostgreSQL column slo_snapshots.burn_rate NUMERIC(5,2) rejected the UPDATE with SQLSTATE 22003 (numeric field overflow), leaving stale seeded 100.00% rows in place.
prevention_rule: 1) Never return 100% or synthetic structs on empty telemetry; use an explicit unmeasured sentinel (-1 / budget_status='unmeasured') or empty slice. 2) Always check numeric_precision and numeric_scale in information_schema.columns for NUMERIC(p,s) columns and clamp computed ratios/rates (e.g. [0, 999.99] for NUMERIC(5,2)) in both usecase and repository layers.

root_cause: 1) Background goroutines (HealthChecker.checkAll, boot-time FleetComplianceScanner) passed bare context.Background() into repositories using BuildTenantQuery, which rewrote SELECT queries to WHERE tenant_id = '' and silently returned 0 rows. 2) After Migration 063 unified tenant_id to VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default-tenant', legacy SQL INSERTs passing literal NULL into tenant_id failed with SQLSTATE 23502. 3) Subagent nested powershell -Command "...$_..." caused outer PowerShell to expand $_ to empty string so Get-Content hung waiting on stdin.
prevention_rule: 1) Every background/boot worker calling tenant-scoped repositories MUST wrap ctx with tenancy.WithPlatformAdminContext(ctx) (or EnsureTenantContext). 2) Never insert literal SQL NULL into NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default-tenant' columns; bind TenantIDOrDefault(ctx). 3) In PowerShell tool calls, never nest powershell -Command "...$_..."; run direct PowerShell expressions.

root_cause: 1) After migrating access JWT from localStorage to memory (authStore), secondary API wrapper management.ts still called api.setToken(localStorage.getItem('token')), overwriting api.token with null whenever /tenancy loaded and causing cascading 401 errors across subsequent screens; logStore/usePodLogs/usePodTerminal also read localStorage directly. 2) Under Vite dev proxy (changeOrigin: true), browsing http://127.0.0.1:3000 sent Origin: http://127.0.0.1:3000 with Host: localhost:8080, failing strict string equality in WebSocket CheckOrigin. 3) config.yaml explicitly set load_balancer.url: http://localhost:8080, overriding code-level DeriveTraefikURL('') defaults and making :8080 poll itself.
prevention_rule: 1) Whenever migrating auth token storage, grep the entire frontend src/ for every localStorage token read AND every setToken() call across all API/composable/WebSocket/SSE modules so zero stale overrides remain. 2) WebSocket same-host origin checks must treat loopback literals (localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1) as equivalent while rejecting any external or subdomain host. 3) Always inspect checked-in config.yaml alongside code defaults and guard background scrapers with IsSelfServerURL(url, serverPort).

root_cause: 1) Base selector button.btn (0,1,1) in buttons.css overrode .btn-primary (0,1,0) with --bg-card in Light Mode, turning modal primary CTA buttons white, while undefined --bg-card-hover fell back to dark #1e293b on hover. 2) Rendering a position: fixed modal inside a parent card with transform/backdrop-filter/overflow trapped the backdrop inside the card stacking context and clipped the modal header. 3) Mismatched media queries (min-width: 640px on mobile cards vs max-width: 767.98px on desktop table) hid both views across 640-767px.
prevention_rule: 1) Always match or exceed base element+class specificity on variant classes (button.btn.btn-primary) and verify every CSS fallback var(--token, fallback) exists in both :root and [data-theme='light'] in tokens.css. 2) Always wrap full-viewport modals in <Teleport to='body'> with max-height: calc(100vh - 48px) and scrollable .modal-body, and auto-hide floating banners via body:has([role='dialog'], ...) in CSS. 3) Pair mobile-card and desktop-table media queries on the exact same breakpoint (768px / 767.98px) and visually inspect 1440px, 768px, and 375px screenshots on the main thread via read_file before sign-off.
